# Fetch all received payment requests (paginate through all pages)
venmo_token = _mem['s9']['access_token']
all_requests = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    all_requests.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total received payment requests: {len(all_requests)}")
# Print all for inspection
for req in all_requests:
    print(req)
